slug: 2025-11-11 Assessing the landscape of digital health implementation for data services in Cameroon
note: The file holds a summary only: a survey of 60 health workers and 6 experts found 80% aware of DHIS2 and 45% reporting interoperability problems with it, 85% unaware of any guidelines; it names DHIS2 without describing what it does, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
